caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition centered on birds, trees, flowers, and foliage set against a tan background. At the top, large green leaves and pink flowers with red centers form a horizontal border, with additional green leaves accented with touches of peach. Below this border, at the upper center, there is an embroidered text section. On either side of the text, pink flowers with green leaves grow upwards, with small birds and geometric patterns interspersed among the foliage, including blue, red, white, and black birds perched on branches. In the center section, there are two prominent trees, one with a large brown trunk and broad green leaves with clusters of red ovals, and another tree-like form arises from a blue pot at the bottom. On branches above, there are two large birds—one with brown and white plumage and another with a red breast—resting among pink blossoms. Additional smaller birds in yellow, blue, and red are scattered on branches and in the foliage throughout the scene. The lower area contains several stylized flowers and potted plants, along with more birds of various colors, some on the ground and others perched on small trees. The overall color palette consists of earthy tones dominated by greens, reds, pinks, browns, yellow, and blue, with each object outlined or filled distinctly to separate elements and create detail within the arrangement.
title: Sampler
